history.overview: The Sanctum Core is the heart of Riftseeker planar manipulation, where elemental forces converge and Discord fractures pulse with unstable energy.

timeline.name: Core Construction
timeline.description: Riftseekers built the core chamber to anchor planar energy flows.

timeline.name: Crystal Conduits
timeline.description: Crystalline conduits were installed to channel elemental Discord.

timeline.name: Muramite Incursions
timeline.description: Muramite forces attempted to breach the core to seize planar power.

timeline.name: Rift Heart Expansion
timeline.description: A planar fracture expanded, forming the unstable Rift Heart chamber.
